why: Both share the same light-ash desk, birch glass-door bookcase and floor lamp. B's birch rocking armchair with a cream cushion is exactly the light-wood Nordic reading chair asked for, while A's dark-brown frame with grey upholstery breaks the palette. B's swivel chair is a bit traditional and honey-toned, but it is a real comfortable work chair, whereas A's dining armchair is less suited to long desk sessions.
